newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan two-month NCD average yield at 7.145 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan two-month NCD average yield at 7.145 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank issued T$8 billion in two-month negotiable certificates of deposit on Tuesday at an average yield of 7.145 percent, a central bank official said.
The range of the bids was between 6.760 and 7.350 percent.

The issue came as late profit-taking on Tuesday halted a bull run in the stock market, which was down 0.72 percent just minutes before close after surging to an seven-year intraday high in early trade.
